name: application-flashcard-flip
title: Flashcard Flip
description: Front/back flashcard components with a 3D flip animation and know/review actions, for study and language-learning apps.
useWhen: Front/back flashcard components with a 3D flip animation and know/review actions, for study and language-learning apps.
avoidWhen: Avoid flashcard flip when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Flashcard Flip uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
